The modifications could compromise vehicle safety, with offenders facing up to two years in prison or fines of 20 million won ($15,000).

stories.title: Deadly Intel Fab 28 explosion causes two-week shutdown, to cost $600 million and severely disrupt server chip manufacturing for six months
stories.summary: A two-week shutdown of Intel's Fab 28 in Israel will affect server CPU shipments for two consecutive quarters.

stories.title: Intel confirms Nova Lake CPUs will use advanced 18A-P node, more details at CES
stories.summary: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake desktop processors will be the first client product to use Intel's enhanced 18A-P node, CEO Lip-Bu Tan confirmed in the company's Q3 2026 earnings call.

stories.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX buying out 418 homes near flagship AI data center, but only if they drop participation in lawsuit
stories.summary: The properties will supposedly house SpaceXSI staff while also giving a chance to those who don't want to live near the data center to sell their homes.

stories.title: AI demand triggers massive PCB shortage for PC makers as order books full until 2030
stories.summary: The AI industry continues to gobble up manufacturing resources that were once dedicated to serving PC, smart device, and gadget makers. Inevitably, the PCB industry has started to feel its effects.

stories.title: US data centers could wipe out 15 years' worth of progress in greenhouse gas emissions, report claims
stories.summary: The Sierra Club, one of the oldest environmental preservation organizations in the U.S., has now put forth an estimate that by 2030, U.S. data center buildouts will be outputting as much carbon dioxide as the entirety of Mexico.

stories.title: Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 prices hit $2,000, costing more than the RTX 5090 did at launch and with limited stock available
stories.summary: It costs just as much to buy an Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 right now as the launch price for the RTX 5090, with prices now at least two times higher for this high spec GPU.

stories.title: HyperX Omen 35L review: A polished gaming PC for deep pockets
stories.summary: Premium styling, quiet operation, and impressive performance elevates the HyperX Omen 35L into competition with the best the market has to offer. But whether it's worth the money depends on which configuration you choose.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang may have been the target of a spy plot through 'Chinese intelligence asset,' report claims
stories.summary: Sources say that Alice Huang, a senior executive at an Nvidia cloud partner who has close ties with Jensen Huang, is suspected of passing information to Beijing.

stories.title: Dept of Justice reportedly probes Nvidia over $13 billion Hugging Face AI platform acquisition
stories.summary: Nvidia's near $13 billion buyout of Hugging Face has come under scrutiny over concerns that it will impact competition in the AI space.

stories.title: Tech whiz's internet-accessible Synology NAS gets bit by ransomware attack from 18-month-old remote code execution flaw
stories.summary: Tech whizz' internet-accessible Synology NAS gets bit by transomware attack — security updates 18 months out of date in a series of catastrophic errors

stories.title: Our first step at defining a CPU benchmark for agentic AI
stories.summary: Over the past six months, CPUs have taken center stage as agentic AI workloads evolve. Here’s our first attempt at trying to measure CPU performance when running agentic workloads.

stories.summary: You can save $1,250 on this Alienware Aurora gaming PC with an RTX 5070 Ti and 32GB of DDR5 RAM, now priced at just $2,599.99.

stories.summary: Fujifilm plans to increase the production of magnetic tape by as much as 5x as it works to meet a newfound demand for AI data center storage.

stories.title: Save $234 on 32GB of DDR5 RAM with this 3-item AM5 Newegg bundle
stories.summary: This Newegg AM5 combo deal is $234 off. Priced at only $1,069, you get a Ryzen7 9800X3D, X870E Aorus Elite Wifi7 board, 32GB of G.Skill DDR5-6000 RAM and a free MSI AIO cooler.

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing shows most of its compute goes to R&D, not serving customers
stories.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 splits its $8.9 billion H1 compute bill: most went to R&D, with less than a third estimated to serve Claude customers.

stories.title: Fake PS5 emulators are being used to steal gamers' passwords
